bodies.notes: Core test case. The working hypothesis ('rename keeps the body') gives one continuous body 1542-present, which matches how the Holy See itself narrates it (Integrae servandae recites 1542 and 1908 as its own history). But 1965 is a rename + change of purpose + new 'ordo' at once, and 1917 adds a whole former congregation (Index). The Pope was prefect until 1968 (REU) — CIC 1917 can. 247; Integrae servandae n.2.
